scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit:server && npm run test:unit:client
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:server && npm run test:integration:client
scripts.test:contract: start-server-and-test "npm run -w tdd-testing-server start" http://localhost:4000/api/health "vitest run --config tests/contract/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.test:smoke: start-server-and-test "npm run -w tdd-testing-server start" http://localhost:4000/api/health "node tests/smoke/smoke.mjs"
scripts.test:perf: start-server-and-test "npm run -w tdd-testing-server start" http://localhost:4000/api/health "node tests/perf/list-clients.perf.mjs"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:contract && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:perf && npm run test:e2e
